Package edu.cnu.mdi.view

Class HeadlessPointerTool

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.view.HeadlessPointerTool
All Implemented Interfaces:
MouseListener, MouseMotionListener, EventListener
public class HeadlessPointerTool extends Object implements MouseListener, MouseMotionListener
A minimal, "headless" pointer tool that enables item dragging (and other item modifications supported by AItem) on views that do not have a visible AToolBar.

In the toolbar-driven workflow, a pointer tool (e.g. PointerButton) is typically responsible for installing mouse listeners and driving AItem modification state (start/modify/stop). This class provides the same essential behavior without requiring a toolbar UI.

Behavior

  • On mouse press, hit-tests for an AItem.
  • If the item is draggable, the tool arms a potential drag.
  • Once the mouse has moved beyond a configurable pixel threshold, the tool creates an ItemModification, calls AItem.startModification(), and then repeatedly calls AItem.modify() as the mouse moves.
  • On mouse release, if a modification was started, the tool calls AItem.stopModification().

This tool intentionally does not attempt to manage selection state or multi-item operations; it is meant for "mini-map"/virtual views such as VirtualView, where the primary goal is simple item dragging.
